### 1 — Scene
A breakfast plate with scrambled eggs, cooked red-skinned potatoes, broccoli, and mixed fruit.

### 2 — Vessel
A large square dinner plate, partly cropped. Using an approximate **26 cm diameter-equivalent eating area** gives:
**3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Scrambled eggs, red-skinned potatoes, broccoli, pineapple, strawberries, blueberries, and yellow-orange fruit that appears to be mango. No separate pool of oil or sauce is visible; modest cooking fat is included in the cooked-food energy estimates.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas represent non-overlapping shares of the plate. Volume is the outer envelope of each pile; density is the only reduction applied.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Scrambled eggs | 28% | 148 × 1.4 = 207 ml | 0.95 | 197 g | 165 | 325 kcal |
| Cooked potatoes | 13% | 69 × 2.2 = 152 ml | 0.65 | 99 g | 120 | 119 kcal |
| Broccoli | 9% | 48 × 2.2 = 106 ml | 0.55 | 58 g | 50 | 29 kcal |
| Pineapple | 13% | 69 × 2.0 = 138 ml | 0.65 | 90 g | 50 | 45 kcal |
| Strawberries | 10% | 53 × 1.6 = 85 ml | 0.60 | 51 g | 32 | 16 kcal |
| Blueberries | 3% | 16 × 1.0 = 16 ml | 0.65 | 10 g | 57 | 6 kcal |
| Mango, estimated | 3% | 16 × 1.6 = 26 ml | 0.65 | 17 g | 60 | 10 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 79% total, consistent with the largely covered plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 522 g and 570 kcal** is plausible for the visible meal. The main uncertainty is the depth of the eggs and how much cooking fat was used.
